orders.text:
FA No. 83 of 2020
Hon’ble Ravi Malimath, J.
Hon’ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, 
advocate for the appellant.
The appellant’s counsel submits 
that so far as office objection regarding 
maintainability it appears to be correct. 
Therefore, he requests the Hon’ble Court 
to permit him to convert this appeal into 
a revision as provided under the Act.
The request is accepted.
Registry is permitted to convert 
this appeal into a revision and allot a 
fresh number.
Registry to place the matter 
before the appropriate court.
The appeal is disposed off for the 
statistical purpose.
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.) (Ravi Malimath, J.)
17.06.2020

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLR No.217 of 2020
Hon’ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
Mr. R.P. Nautilyal, learned senior counsel 
assisted by Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned counsel 
for the revisionist.
Ms. Mamta Joshi, learned B.H. for the State.
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for the 
private respondent.
As per the impugned order dated 06.03.2020 
passed by the Judge, Family Court, Vikasnagar, 
Dehradun, the revisionist was directed to pay 
Rs.8,000/- per month as maintenance.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the 
respondent that the revisionist has failed to pay the 
maintenance allowance as awarded by the Judge, 
Family Court.
List on 13.01.2022 along with connected 
matter.
On that day, both the parties will remain 
present before the Court for mediation.
In the meantime, the revisionist will deposit 
the entire maintenance amount @ Rs.5,000/- per 
month by way of demand draft before the Court.
On the next date of hearing the revisionist 
husband will pay Rs.10,000/- to the respondent wife 
as travelling expenses.
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.) 
 21.12.2021
Sukhbant
